objectiveHistory: Lock down expected overflow behavior for TUI single-line controls so the recommendation matches intended UX

entries.commandOrAction: Clamp every rendered row to terminal width
entries.expect: No crash; stable layout; selectors show truncated labels/descriptions

entries.commandOrAction: Keep horizontal scrolling for editors/inputs, truncate non-editable rows, and keep a final TUI-level clamp as a safety net
entries.expect: No crash; good UX for editing and selectors

answers.prompt: When a single-line TUI row would exceed terminal width, what should be the default behavior?

notes: Discovery found real overflows in SelectList, Input, and coding-agent session selector, plus inconsistent TUI enforcement between initial full render and later diff renders.
